descriptions.certificates_delete: Delete a TLS certificate from the account. Required: id of the certificate to remove (list certificates first to find it). Destructive and irreversible — sessions using this certificate will fail TLS trust afterward.
descriptions.certificates_list: List all TLS certificates uploaded to the account. Returns an array of Certificate objects with id, name, and metadata. Use with `certificates get` to inspect a specific certificate.
descriptions.contexts_delete: Delete a persistent browser context. Required: id of the context to remove. Destructive and irreversible — any session that references this context will lose its persisted state (cookies, localStorage).
descriptions.extensions_delete: Delete an uploaded browser extension from the account. Required: id of the extension to remove. Destructive and irreversible — sessions that reference this extension will fail to load it.
descriptions.projects_list: List all Browserbase projects on the account. Returns an array of Project objects with id, name, defaultTimeout, and concurrency. Use the project id with `projects usage` or `sessions create --project-id`.
